Name: ligand_id
Description: Unique identifier of the ligand in the annotation table

Name: ligand_binding_affinity
Description: Median pKi or pKd for uncensored BindingDB measurements with one endpoint and a target sequence matching this ligand's receptor; missing if ambiguous

Name: ligand_binding_affinity_endpoint
Description: BindingDB endpoint (Ki or Kd) used for ligand_binding_affinity

Name: ligand_binding_affinity_measurement_count
Description: Number of BindingDB measurements used for ligand_binding_affinity

Name: system_has_binding_affinity
Description: Whether any ligand in the system has an unambiguous, sequence-matched BindingDB affinity
